capabilities.title: Point observation
capabilities.description: Validated point locations rendered as map symbols and, when a validated finite height in meters is present, as evidence columns in the anchored local-metric 3D frame.

capabilities.title: Path
capabilities.description: Validated line geometry rendered as a map line layer with the same selection and fit coordination as point evidence.

capabilities.title: Vertical profile evidence
capabilities.description: Located features carrying validated finite heights in meters, rendered as true-height columns about the validated study anchor in the separate Three.js viewport. Marker radii are schematic symbology; positions and heights are to scale and nothing is invented.

notes: Generic semantic/geometric capabilities only: no entry encodes a document, place, publisher, or report.
Only browser-verified implementations are listed. The deterministic synthetic fixtures live under tests/fixtures/ and never enter the package registry or the landing experience.

reasons: Critique remediation for run bootstrap-default: the enabled-3D path is now reachable through a generic adapter gate (located bounds plus a validated finite height in meters) and is browser-verified with the synthetic-3d fixture, so point-observation (map + 3D), path (map), and vertical-profile (3D) are staged as verified.

Final-review remediation (writer stage, no live-registry edits): the synthetic-3d transect line now uses a distinct representative location so all four evidence columns are individually visible; the 3D toolbar and provenance caption fit the retained 1280x720 frame; the disabled 3D/Split reason is visible header text (data-testid mode-3d-reason), not tooltip-only. No capability or fixture-id changes were needed, so verified_fixture_ids are unchanged.

No study package was accepted at bootstrap, so the package registry proposal remains empty. Both deterministic synthetic fixtures stay under tests/fixtures/ and never enter the registry or the landing experience.
Promotion of this staged delta (live-registry write plus post-promotion parse/validation) is reserved for the owner finalizer step; the writer stage performed no live writes.
